skill.name: azure-ai-textanalytics-py
skill.description: Use Azure AI Text Analytics from Python for sentiment, entities, PII, key phrases, language detection, healthcare NLP, batch analysis, and async clients.
skill.summary: Guide Azure AI Text Analytics SDK usage for Python NLP workflows.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The static findings are mostly false positives from Markdown code fences, inline API names, and Python import examples. A contextual privacy concern remains because the skill demonstrates PII and healthcare analytics through Azure AI Language, which needs clear data handling guidance.

remediation.issue: PII and healthcare examples lack an explicit privacy warning.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to use synthetic data in examples, obtain approval before processing regulated data, and document Azure data handling policies.

remediation.issue: Examples print extracted PII and clinical entities.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer redacted outputs and safe logging examples, especially near PII and healthcare workflows.

remediation.issue: Credential setup could be clearer for production use.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend Entra ID or a managed secret store, and state that API keys must not be committed or logged.

semantic_findings.title: Sensitive Data Sent to External AI Service
semantic_findings.description: The skill includes PII and healthcare analysis examples that send text documents to Azure AI Language service. This is legitimate functionality, but it needs explicit data handling guidance for real PII or health data.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The examples directly call PII and healthcare analytics APIs with sample sensitive text. The data is synthetic and the service is expected, so the concern is privacy guidance rather than malicious intent.

content.user_title: Analyze Text with Azure AI Language
content.value_statement: Text teams need repeatable Azure Language examples for common NLP tasks. This skill shows concise Python patterns for authentication, analysis calls, batching, async use, and result handling.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to install the Azure AI Text Analytics Python SDK.
Demonstrates API key and Entra ID authentication patterns.
Covers sentiment, opinion mining, entities, PII, key phrases, and language detection.
Includes healthcare entity analysis and linked medical data source examples.
Shows batch actions and async client usage for higher throughput.
limitations: Requires an Azure Language resource, endpoint, and valid credentials.
Provides examples, not a complete production application.
Does not document pricing, regional limits, quotas, or data retention terms.
Requires privacy review before processing real PII or health data.

use_cases.title: Review Customer Feedback
use_cases.description: Analyze comments for sentiment, opinion targets, entities, and key phrases before reporting trends.

use_cases.title: Prepare NLP Pipelines
use_cases.description: Prototype Azure Language calls for batch processing, async workflows, and document-level error handling.

use_cases.title: Prototype Clinical Text Features
use_cases.description: Explore healthcare entity extraction with synthetic clinical text before compliance and privacy review.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up the Client
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to show the basic Azure AI Text Analytics Python setup. Include installation, required environment variables, and client initialization.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Feedback Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft a workflow that analyzes customer comments for sentiment, opinion mining, entities, and key phrases.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Sensitive Data Handling
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a PII detection workflow for support messages. Include redaction, logging safeguards, and validation before production.

prompt_templates.title: Design Batch Processing
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline a high-throughput Azure Text Analytics pipeline. Include batch actions, async clients, retries, and limits to verify.

output_examples.input: Analyze customer feedback for sentiment and key themes.
output_examples.output: A concise implementation plan naming the Azure operations, required inputs, expected results, and review steps.

output_examples.input: Prepare PII detection for support tickets.
output_examples.output: A privacy-focused workflow with redaction, safe logging guidance, validation checks, and deployment cautions.

output_examples.input: Compare authentication choices for Azure Text Analytics.
output_examples.output: A short recommendation covering Entra ID, API keys, environment configuration, and production credential handling.

best_practices: Use Entra ID or managed secrets instead of hard-coded API keys.
Batch documents within service limits and handle document-level errors.
Use synthetic data until privacy approval covers real PII or health data.
anti_patterns: Do not print or log raw PII from analysis results.
Do not commit endpoints, API keys, or sample secrets to source control.
Do not treat NLP output as authoritative without domain review.

faq.question: Does this skill run Azure requests by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides SDK guidance and examples. Users still need an Azure Language resource and credentials.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it support Entra ID authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples include Entra ID with default Azure credentials and API key authentication.

faq.question: Can it help with PII redaction?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers PII entity recognition and redacted text output from Azure AI Text Analytics.

faq.question: Does it cover async processing?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes an async client example and batch action patterns for larger workloads.

faq.question: Is the healthcare example production ready?
faq.answer: No. Treat it as a starting point and complete privacy, compliance, and clinical validation first.
